answer: The strongest single control I know for this is state proof via SPV Merkle branch verification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 779 fakes spends 13243 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. What carries the jade here is verification, the reef of cost is what stops the farm, and the bridge of the record keeps every claim checkable. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
